# "Did the new feature rollout raise the bill?"
1. Group by Service
   -> Compute: ~$4,000 last month -> ~$5,600 this month
2. Filter by tag: project=new-feature
   -> confirms the increase sits inside that team's own resources
caption: Group broadly first, then filter narrowly by tag — same pattern in both tools.
